props.label: Public terminal (ME3)
props.note: ME3's free-standing Citadel kiosk from Docking Bay D24 (BioApl_Uti_Terminal01), a quest's terminal to repair. Its screen is only painted dark on the front face, so its two looks are quads over it with D24's own hologram textures: Holomod_05 in hologram blue when repaired, the red warning ring (H_Graphs3) when broken.
